notes.title: Server Merge Notice
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38235056/a9bcd045160c7b21fd6761f5a8d84e7c38bff7e4.jpg

Hello Rebirthers!

In order to provide better service regarding in-game activities and also support to all our users, we will merge the game servers.

It scheduled for this week.
Please check the details below:

========================================
Rhea will be integrated with Hyperion
- Server name : Hyperion
========================================

These changes will not only allow us to offer all our users, a higher service quality and server improvements, but also a better ground for upcoming content.

■Guide

[Account]
1. Guest account data will be deleted, so please make sure to link your account to others.

[Login]
1. Select the server name as follows
- Please select the Hyperion (no more Rhea Server)

[Character]
1. Each account has 4 character slots
- If the number of characters registered in one account is more than four in both server,
Other characters over the 4 characters must be deleted to enter the game.
※ Deleted characters cannot be restored
2. Renaming a character
- All the names of characters must be changed after the merge
- When you will have the first login, you can see the following example
(Ex. Before: Ranger → After: Ranger#SERVER)
- You need to change the name to enter into the game.
※ Since character name is not authorized, priority will be given to the user who changed first

[Social]
- You can keep friends that were added to your friend list after the server merged
※ The friends who changed their names will look normal when they reconnect.

[Mailbox]
- Mail archived before server merge remains even after the server merge.

[Guild]

notes.title: In-game store steam Pop up window: Solution
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38235056/90871bf15645ac33e1cc60a890d5f2cdd3e0016f.jpg

We noticed that some users are not having the Steam Pop up window when trying to purchase from the In-game Shop.

Solution 1 – Disable and re-enable the Steam Overlay for individual games

1. Open Steam.
2. Click on the Steam and then Settings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38235056/c2c8098f2fed9d36fa4baacf6c8e7d9cd60c311f.png

3. Choose  In-game from the left pane.
4. Check the “Enable the Steam Overlay while in-game” box and confirm changes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38235056/c04a7f42577e983569d1f32b920222490140ce1e.png

5. Now, open Library, right-click on the affected game and open Properties.
6. Check the “Enable the Steam Overlay while in-game” box and save changes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38235056/c747ef2169b9e42b88f5819f7563a053460faa32.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38235056/a4159f04da44ff7402fe6644efba4db157dd3003.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38235056/e38c0448f6219e4f4b60045beac10f0c6fd478c6.png

7. Restart Steam and start the game.

Solution 2 – Run the Steam client as an administrator

1. Right-click on the Steam client’s desktop shortcut and open Properties.
2. Choose the Compatibility tab.
3. Check the “Run this program as an administrator” box and confirm changes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38235056/9140ac018a1e2c1c4d222d3c89c76b24c64e021f.png

Please let us know if the problem persists. Thank you for the support.
Thank you.
